epicenter.name: Westlake / Pike Pine
epicenter.why: Downtown life concentrates at the Westlake transit/pike-pine retail seam, not at Columbia Center; ad density, pedestrian field and commute direction key on this point. Pike Place is the symbolic heart; Westlake is where the transit pulse actually lands.

attribution: Derived from the Manhattan radial+daily field template, re-parameterized for Seattle; no external dataset.
